name: Vibration-isolation table
model: Newport or TMC optical table (configuration pending)
geometryBrief: Honeycomb tabletop, hole grid, legs and air isolators.
behaviorBrief: Snap instrument fixtures; optional vibration noise parameter.
inputs: Table hole pattern, mount footprint and pose, fixture anchors and optional noise spectrum
outputs: Table-to-fixture transform, occupied mounts and optional fixture vibration input
acceptance: Snap a two-hole mount to a matching grid and translate the table. Relative mount coordinates must remain fixed; an incompatible hole spacing must refuse attachment.

name: Shielded enclosure
model: Custom Faraday cage / patch rig enclosure
geometryBrief: Mesh panels, access door, grounding point and cable ports.
behaviorBrief: Noise attenuation proxy; not a claim of real shielding performance.
inputs: Enclosure and ground connection state, coupled pickup trace and declared shielding factor
outputs: State-tagged pickup component for the acquisition noise model
acceptance: Inject a pure test tone with an illustrative 20 dB amplitude reduction in the closed state. Its amplitude should fall to one tenth and return when the modeled shielding is removed.

name: Precision laboratory bench
model: Custom 1800 x 750 x 900 mm steel bench (design choice)
geometryBrief: Steel top, cream cabinets, drawers, legs, adjustable feet and cable grommets.
behaviorBrief: Grabbable trays, drawer states and workstation anchor points.
inputs: Bench geometry, load footprint, anchor and drawer state, tray inventory
outputs: Occupied anchor map, drawer transforms and tray locations
acceptance: Move a tray into an open drawer and close it. The tray must retain its ID and drawer-relative pose, while another object cannot claim its occupied slot.

name: Ultrapure water system
purpose: Represent water supply for wet and biological processes.
geometryBrief: Cabinet, dispenser arm, hose and screen.
behaviorBrief: Water-quality and dispensing state as a virtual resource.
inputs: Virtual water inventory, requested volume, destination capacity and quality record
outputs: Dispense event, remaining inventory and destination volume with lot/quality provenance
acceptance: Dispense 100 mL from a 1 L virtual supply to an empty compatible bottle. The ledger should show 900 mL remaining and the bottle should retain the incoming lot ID.

name: Autoclave
geometryBrief: Chamber, hinged door, trays and control panel.
behaviorBrief: Cycle status and sample compatibility; no real sterilization validation.
inputs: Virtual load identifiers and compatibility flags, chamber/door state and abstract cycle events
outputs: Cycle-state history and compatible supply processing records
acceptance: Try a flagged incompatible load, then cancel a compatible mock run halfway through. Neither case should produce a completed-cycle event.

name: Precision balance
geometryBrief: Draft shield, pan, display, doors and leveling feet.
behaviorBrief: Mass measurement with tare and noise; no need to model internal electronics.
inputs: Pan load, tare mass, calibration, display increment and optional noise seed
outputs: Tared mass reading with units, resolution and calibration ID
acceptance: With noise disabled, tare a 2 g container and add a 5 g reference weight. Read zero before addition and 5 g afterward to the configured display increment.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric AE100 with traceable dimensions and inferred details
simulationStatus: Deterministic tare, gross capacity, rounding and synthetic gain verified
integrationStatus: Simulator, reading-log JSON and named actions; headset not tested

name: Water bath
model: Fisher Scientific Isotemp water bath (model pending)
purpose: Maintain virtual samples at controlled temperature.
geometryBrief: Stainless bath, lid, rack, thermometer and panel.
inputs: Bath set point and initial state, sample IDs, thermal time constants and simulation clock
outputs: Bath and sample temperature histories with exposure timestamps
acceptance: Start a colder virtual sample in a constant-temperature bath. Under a first-order model the sample should close 63.2% of the initial temperature gap in one time constant.

name: Liquid handling
purpose: Transfer and track small sample volumes.
geometryBrief: Plunger, ejector, tips, body and pipette stand.
behaviorBrief: Volume, container transfer, tip use and sample lineage.
inputs: Pipette volume range, tip state, transfer volume and source/destination container IDs
outputs: Paired volume debits/credits, transfer event, tip status and aliquot lineage
acceptance: Transfer 25 µL from a 100 µL source to an empty vessel with an attached tip. Expect 75 and 25 µL with linked identities; a request above remaining volume must leave both volumes unchanged.

name: Hotplate / stirrer
geometryBrief: Ceramic top, control knobs, stir bar and beaker.
behaviorBrief: Temperature and mixing state; virtual process only.
inputs: Virtual vessel, heater/stirrer state, temperature probe and mixing-state model
outputs: Temperature history and agitation state associated with the vessel
acceptance: Disable heating and cooling in an equilibrium phantom; switch stirring on and off. The mixing state should follow the control while temperature stays at the configured equilibrium.

name: Ultrasonic cleaner
model: Branson benchtop ultrasonic cleaner (exact model pending)
geometryBrief: Steel tank, removable basket, lid and panel.
behaviorBrief: Cleaning state and time; avoid assigning unvalidated cleanliness.
inputs: Basket contents, part compatibility, virtual run duration and cancellation event
outputs: Per-part cleaning-cycle history with elapsed time and completion state
acceptance: Cancel a 60 s mock cycle at 20 s. The part record should report 20 s elapsed and interrupted status, with no completed-cycle entry.

name: Cleanroom sample handling
model: Custom wafer cassette, tweezers, vacuum wand and carriers
purpose: Move wafers and chips through fabrication steps.
geometryBrief: 100/150 mm wafers, carriers, mask boxes, tweezers and wand; physical sizes explicit.
behaviorBrief: Attach sample IDs to holders; prevent incompatible size/port connections.
inputs: Wafer ID and diameter, holder slot size, tool attachment and custody state
outputs: Holder/slot occupancy and sample-custody transfer event
acceptance: Move a 100 mm wafer into a matching slot, then attempt insertion into an undersized carrier. Only the first placement should change custody; the wafer ID must remain unique.

name: General lab sample ware
model: Custom dishes, multiwell plates, tubes, vials and racks
purpose: Carry cells, scaffolds and test samples.
geometryBrief: Transparent plastics/glass, lids, meniscus, racks, labels and removable caps.
behaviorBrief: Container capacity, sample ID, volume and location; use instancing.
inputs: Container and well IDs, capacity, aliquot volumes, rack pose and sample lineage
outputs: Per-well volume/identity ledger and rack-relative sample locations
acceptance: Load different labeled aliquots into wells A1 and A2, move the rack, then attempt to overfill A1. Both labels and volumes must survive the move and rejected overfill.

name: Cable and connector library
model: Custom BNC, SMA, USB, triax, FFC and headstage families
purpose: Link instruments to samples and each other.
geometryBrief: Connector shells, pins only where visible, flexible cables and strain relief.
behaviorBrief: Typed ports, compatible mating, bend radius and data path; no cable solver unless needed.
inputs: Source and sink port types, pin map, signal class, cable endpoints and allowed bend radius
outputs: Validated connection edge, channel routing and bend warnings
acceptance: Route a known pulse through a compatible BNC signal path and verify the receiving channel ID. A direct SMA-to-BNC attempt without a modeled adapter must create no connection.

name: Vacuum/gas service props
model: Custom pump, regulator, tubing, gauge and manifold families
purpose: Give deposition and microscopy systems coherent service context.
geometryBrief: Pump cabinets, gauges, hoses, gas panel and brackets.
behaviorBrief: Show equipment ready/idle state and virtual connections; no physical gas or vacuum operating procedure.
inputs: Virtual service endpoint types, manifold connection graph and service availability state
outputs: Service-availability events and connected instrument readiness flags
acceptance: Connect two instruments to distinct abstract service branches and disconnect one branch. Only dependent instruments should lose readiness; reconnecting must restore their prior linkage.

name: Storage, safety & lighting
model: Custom cabinets, lab stools, PPE, amber glazing and task lamps
purpose: Make the virtual room coherent and comfortable.
geometryBrief: Cream enamel, olive fabric, brass/steel details, glass partitions, drawers and pendant lights.
behaviorBrief: Door/drawer and lighting controls; decorative models are not safety-certified real equipment.
inputs: Cabinet or drawer ID, item location, fixture pose and task-lamp switch state
outputs: Storage occupancy, moving-part poses and scene lighting state
acceptance: Store a labeled item, close and reopen its drawer, then switch the task lamp. The same item must occupy the same drawer slot and only the lamp's illumination state should change.
